name: Calm Health
short_description: Clinical mental health and wellness platform from Calm, offering evidence-based programs for anxiety, depression, sleep, and stress for employers and health plans.
long_description: Calm Health is the clinical-grade enterprise offering from Calm, the world's leading mental wellness app with over 150 million downloads. Launched to address the growing need for scalable mental health solutions, Calm Health provides evidence-based programs designed in partnership with clinical experts for anxiety, depression, sleep disorders, and chronic stress. Unlike the consumer Calm app focused on meditation and sleep stories, Calm Health offers structured clinical pathways, outcome measurement, and engagement analytics for employers and health plans. The platform integrates CBT-based interventions, mindfulness training, and sleep programs with routine symptom assessments to track clinical improvement. Calm Health reports ROI metrics including reduced healthcare costs, improved productivity, and decreased absenteeism. The company raised $75M in 2021, reaching a $2 billion valuation, and serves major enterprise customers.
one_liner: Clinical wellness platform from Calm with evidence-based programs for enterprise mental health.
best_for: Employers seeking scalable mental wellness benefits
Health plans looking for stress and sleep management solutions
HR teams measuring mental health program engagement and ROI
not_for: Organizations needing clinical treatment for severe mental illness

pricing.notes: Calm Health enterprise pricing separate from consumer app. Includes admin dashboard, engagement analytics, and clinical outcome tracking.

clinical_evidence.research_studies: Multiple peer-reviewed studies on meditation and sleep

faqs.q: How is Calm Health different from the Calm app?
faqs.a: Calm Health is the enterprise B2B offering with clinical-grade programs, outcome tracking, and engagement analytics for employers and health plans. The consumer Calm app focuses on meditation and sleep stories for individuals.

faqs.q: Does Calm Health include outcome measurement?
faqs.a: Yes, Calm Health includes clinical outcome tracking with routine symptom assessments to measure improvement in anxiety, depression, sleep, and stress levels.
Yes, Calm Health is HIPAA compliant, SOC 2 Type II certified, and GDPR compliant. They provide BAAs for healthcare organizations and employers.

faqs.q: What conditions does Calm Health address?
faqs.a: Calm Health offers evidence-based programs for anxiety, depression, sleep difficulties, and chronic stress, developed in partnership with clinical experts using CBT and mindfulness approaches.
